transcript.text: Which region is the leading region? Answer with the region name.

args.intent: leading region sales revenue by region

args.sql:
SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM memory.bench.customers c
JOIN memory.bench.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY order_count DESC

transcript.text:
West is the leading region with 339 orders, the most among all regions.

FINAL ANSWER: West
